name: Mirza ghasemi
description: Charred aubergine mashed with garlic, tomato and egg into a smoky spread.

tcm.note: Aubergine is cool; the garlic and egg warm it.

ayurveda.note: Vrintaka and anda are both ushna.

unani.note: Baingan is garam in the eastern reading.

histamine.note: Aubergine, tomato and egg — three high items, and nothing else in the dish.
